text:
maya: ok team, quick watercooler q — what’s everyone’s top guilty-pleasure TV episode? I need something shortish to binge tonight. also: summer book club poll — sci-fi or fantasy? vote + recs pls

raj: guilty-pleasure episode = "The Office" S2E12 (The Injury). ridiculous and comforting. :joy:

ellie: ooh love that one. mine is Parks and Rec S3E2 (Flu Season). classic Leslie chaos.

samir: guilty pick: Brooklyn Nine-Nine S1E22 — the heist. silly but perfect 20-min watch.

jess: rec: Schitt's Creek S4E13 (Meet the Company) — tears and swoon. also vote: sci-fi > fantasy for me.

maya: vote: fantasy (short modern fantasy recs please).

raj: tagged: @ellie since she reads a lot — sci-fi recs?

ellie: sci-fi rec: The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet (Becky Chambers) — warm, low-conflict, excellent for summer.

ellie: fantasy rec (if you change mind): Uprooted by Naomi Novik — standalone, fast-paced.

samir: quick poll result: sci-fi 2, fantasy 2 (including my change), undecided: maya.

maya: tie-breaker: fantasy. book recs appreciated!

jess: guilty-pleasure soundtrack: throwback guilty-pleasure ep = "Glee" S1E1 if anyone needs karaoke energy. :microphone:

giphy-bot: [GIF: tiny dancing alien — reaction to book club split]

raj: also adding a micro-list for 20-40 minute feel-good ep: Ted Lasso S1E5, The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel S1E3, Flight of the Conchords S1E1.

maya: perfect. I'll start with The Injury then maybe Chambers for sci-fi warm vibes if y'all change your minds. thanks for the fast recs! :heart:

samir: note: if anyone wants to add to the summer list, drop titles below and i'll pin them to #book-club.

jess: added Uprooted + Long Way to the shared doc: https://tiny.redwood/readlist (placeholder)

ellie: also: guilty podcast ep if anyone wants audio: Conan O'Brien Needs a Friend S2E14 — laugh-out-loud.

maya: end thread — cheers and enjoy weekend binges :sparkles:
